inclusion_rule: EEG decoding studies (classification, text or speech decoding) that train a denoising diffusion model as part of the decoder, either jointly with a classifier, as a feature learner, or to generate training samples. Boundary: diffusion used only to synthesize EEG with no decoding result, reviews, and 'diffusion' in a non-generative sense (drift-diffusion, diffusion MRI) are excluded; versions of one study count once.
